design.class_specific_method: independent label-gated add or replacement; our heuristic, not Warner replication
design.future_test_policy: carry all six primary variants and declared controls; no test-based selection
design.global_weight_rule: normalized positive Jaccard from prior all142 human-reference individual counts

limitations: Later exploratory extension of a benchmark already used by earlier methods; not a new untouched holdout.
Manual142 informed weights, selected classes and adopted NLI cutoff; its gains are design diagnostics.
Report all six primary methods and eight controls, including negative outcomes; no test-based retuning or selection.
Nominal paired intervals condition on fixed predictions, without multiplicity, training-seed or design-reuse adjustment.
Test and development cohorts differ in reference source and relation prevalence; cross-cohort F1 differences are descriptive.
Both full24-label members score every bag; selective rules do not save inference.
Pair latency is a sum of separate member means; joint service latency, joint RSS and fusion overhead are unmeasured.

paired_intervals.method: paired whole-bag percentile; conditional fixed rules; nominal; no design-reuse or multiplicity correction
